evidence_contract.claim: Given an identical correct subject key, the full bitemporal supersession machinery is compared against a plain ORDER BY observed_at DESC recency tiebreak at telling a live coding convention from a retired one, on 1063 MemoryCode supersession probes over 257 instances.

instrument_verification.license_evidence: Cohere-Labs-Community/MemoryCode LICENSE file, recorded in benchmarks/manifests/memorycode.lock.json

evidence_contract.mechanism_evidence: Both arms oracle-keyed and therefore NOT comparable to a lexical baseline; the comparison is mechanism-vs-mechanism with the key held fixed. Liveness verified from each arm's own scratch DB: bitemporal 7198 supersedes edges / 3599 superseded / 3599 valid-closed / 0 open-key range overlaps; control 0 / 0 / 0 with 10294 overlapping open-row pairs and 1060 subject keys carrying competing live rows. Both arms retained the same 7095 preference assertions and 3394 episodes; the bitemporal arm's extra 3599 rows are materialised closed generations. Pruning-placement confound (prereg 7): the bitemporal arm prunes retired rows in SQL, the control prunes after fusion, and this is only harmless because no recall family truncates at this corpus scale (~42 units/scope vs tightest cap 100); the finding does not transfer to scopes carrying 200+ units per subject.
